content: It includes detailed citations of research articles, authors, publication years, journal names, and topics related to infection control, hand hygiene, prevention of bloodstream infections, ventilator-associated pneumonia, and other healthcare-associated infections. These references highlight the impact of interventions such as evidence-based bundles, multidimensional approaches, and compliance with hygiene guidelines in reducing infection rates in healthcare settings globally. The studies span multiple countries and healthcare environments, emphasizing the importance of infection prevention strategies in improving patient outcomes and safety.
